The performance & memory round — every change below is measured (release-build harnesses and a real 390 MB asset store).

## Memory

- **Extension runtimes give memory back.** A drained runtime thread now retires: after an extension finishes its work, its freed heap is returned to the system instead of being parked forever (measured: 113 MB right after an execute → 17 MB two seconds later, zero resident threads). One-shot `setTimeout` initializers no longer pin a runtime alive, and idle runtimes stopped waking once a second for nothing.
- **Startup stops hashing the disk.** `AssetStore::open` no longer reads and hashes every asset file: 1.8 s and a 160 MB RSS peak → milliseconds at baseline. Producer covers live in a disposable `covers/` directory wiped at every start, so the ~390 MB they had accumulated is gone and can never grow across restarts.

## CPU

- **~55% fewer idle wakeups on the server.** The unconditional 100 ms tool tick is gone — timers fire by deadline and the loop parks when nothing runs. Tool tiles tick once per second instead of five, and stop entirely when the window is hidden.
- **Playing media goes quiet between heartbeats.** Position pushes are dead-banded: a steadily playing track pushes once per 10 s instead of once per second (clients already interpolate the position locally; a 10 s heartbeat bounds the drift). Pauses, seeks, track and cover changes still push instantly.
- **Cover art travels by digest.** The per-second base64 encode, full-string compare and double SHA-256 are gone (~0.75 MB of allocations per second → ~0); bytes re-send only when the cover actually changes, and app names come from a per-session cache instead of enumerating the registry every poll.

## Fixes

- **Spotify tiles survive transient errors.** An offline poll or a 5xx no longer blanks tiles to idle — the last track, liked state and volume stay as they were, and the retry went from 20 s to 5 s.
- The current cover can no longer be evicted from the art cache while it is on screen.
- A flaky locale-dependent test was fixed (parallel tests now pin the locale).

## Install

- **Desktop**: update in-app or grab `pulpit-desktop-1.6.1.exe` below — the updater feed is already pointing here.
- **Android**: install `pulpit-1.6.1.apk` over the previous version (same signing key as 1.6.0).
